title: Crunchy Turkish Salad
description: A refreshing salad with crunchy elements and a zesty twist, inspired by Turkish flavors.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, crunchy almonds, diced cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and red onion.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
3. Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
6. Serve chilled, garnished with additional crunchy almonds if desired.
